items.reply: I retain TP: the PR changes the user-visible string assigned in CalendarManager.ts:230, so the exemption for code merely moved or re-indented does not apply. This affects rendered calendar content, making it a localization defect rather than a wording nit; medium reflects the incorrect localized output when hideCalendarNotes is enabled.
